title: Revenue Operations Manager - Sales Excellence
description:
About SoSafe

SoSafe is a leading human risk management platform designed to transform the "human factor" from a security vulnerability into a proactive layer of defense. We focus on driving measurable behavior change and quantifiable risk reduction for our global customers.

Your Role: Drive Sales Performance & Velocity

As Revenue Operations Manager for Sales Excellence, you will be the strategic partner to our Sales leadership and the operational engine behind our Account Executives. Across the SaaS industry, sales cycles have recently increased by 3-4 weeks on average. Furthermore, industry-wide SQL to Closed-Won conversion rates have dropped. Your core mission is to counteract these market headwinds by optimizing our sales mechanics, critical processes, and pipeline management.

You will ensure that our AEs spend less time on administrative friction and more time executing a frictionless, high-converting sales process tailored to our mid-market European buyers.

What you will own (key responsibilities)

  • Operationalize the 2026 ICP: Drive strict alignment with our new Ideal Customer Profile, focusing our AE efforts on corporate to mid-enterprise EU organizations with 500 to 5,000 employees. Equip the sales team to prioritize accounts in regulated industries (e.g., Manufacturing, Finance, Healthcare) that are driven by compliance mandates like NIS2 and DORA.

  • Optimize our Buyer Journey: Tailor our Salesforce deal stages and qualification methodology to engage the right stakeholders at the right time. Specifically, build workflows that help AEs navigate the Head of IT, who acts as the primary decision-maker in our core mid-market deals.

description:

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
Über HeyVera

Unsere KI-Assistentin Vera übernimmt die Telefonie für Hausverwaltungen: Sie nimmt Anliegen auf, erkennt Notfälle und spielt alles direkt in die Verwaltersoftware ein. Über 250 Hausverwaltungen setzen bereits auf HeyVera, und wir wachsen schnell. Unser Ziel: Customer Success, der mit KI und Automatisierung skaliert, nicht mit immer mehr Köpfen.

Deine Mission

Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden mit HeyVera erfolgreich starten, Vera langfristig optimal nutzen und mit uns wachsen. Du bist technische Ansprechperson, Beraterin oder Berater und Vertriebspersönlichkeit in einer Person. Perspektivisch übernimmst du die Leitung unseres Customer-Success- und Support-Bereichs.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest Onboarding und Betreuung unserer Kunden, vom Start bis zum produktiven, langfristigen Einsatz.

  • Du richtest Schnittstellen zu Verwaltersoftware mit ein, analysierst technische Fragen selbst und koordinierst Lösungen mit unserer Entwicklung.

  • Du erkennst Upsell-Potenziale (Integrationen, Lizenzen, Tarife) und führst die Gespräche dazu eigenständig, mit messbaren Wachstumszielen.

  • Du baust mit Tools wie n8n, Make, ChatGPT oder Claude automatisierte Workflows für Onboarding, Support, Follow-ups und Check-ins.

  • Du definierst und steuerst Kennzahlen wie Churn, Time-to-Value, Produktnutzung und Expansion-ARR.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Customer Success, Account Management oder technischem Support bei einem B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen

  • Nachweisbare Vertriebserfahrung, idealerweise Upsell im Bestandskundengeschäft

  • Verständnis von APIs, Softwareintegrationen und digitalen Workflows

  • Praktische Erfahrung damit, eigene Abläufe mit KI-Tools zu automatisieren

  • Kommunikationsstärke, auch in schwierigen Kundengesprächen, und sehr gutes Deutsch

title: Senior Partner, Germany
description:
About the Role

A legal technology company is seeking a Senior Partner to help grow an AI-enabled law practice in Germany. You will bring an established client practice, continue advising clients, and help move recurring legal work onto AI-powered workflows.

What You'll Do

  • Help shape the firm's growth and contribute to its path toward Series A.

  • Transition your portable client practice to the firm's platform while continuing to serve those clients.

  • Build market credibility and develop opportunities through your private equity, venture capital, and mid-market network.

  • Identify cross-selling opportunities for commercial and compliance services across your client base.

  • Work with the founding team to automate recurring legal matters using AI agents.

What We're Looking For

  • 12 to 20 or more years of German legal practice, with experience at partner level.

  • German-qualified Volljurist admitted as a Rechtsanwalt, with native-level German and professional English.

  • A personally portable book of business valued at €1 million or more, with a diversified client base that follows you independently of a large-firm brand.

  • Strong relationships with private equity or venture capital firms and their portfolio companies, or a comparable mid-market client network.

  • Experience with recurring, automatable work such as commercial contracts, IT and data, corporate and venture capital, or regulatory matters.

  • Practical experience using AI tools such as Clau

title: Senior Sales Development Representative (m/w/d)
description:
Ralph baut das Operating System für Wohnimmobilien. Der Markt ist riesig, und er läuft noch größtenteils auf Aktenordnern, Outlook und USB-Sticks. Wir sind der erste AI Property Manager, der auf einem eigenen Operating System läuft, und betreiben Gebäude damit End-to-End. Ralph OS automatisiert Zahlungen, Buchhaltung, Compliance und Kommunikation. AI-Agenten bereiten die Arbeit vor, und unser Team gibt sie frei. Die Hausverwaltung ist unser Einstieg. Das Ziel ist die neue Infrastruktur für die ganze Kategorie, mit Fintech, Versicherung und Finanzierung auf derselben Plattform. Heute verwalten wir über 10.000 Wohneinheiten und wachsen schnell, organisch und durch Zukäufe. Verantwortung bekommst du bei uns früh, und was du baust, nutzen wir direkt im Alltag.

Deine Rolle

Unser Ziel ist es, die größte deutsche Hausverwaltung durch Buy & Build aufzubauen. Du baust dafür den M&A Funnel auf, der dieses Wachstum trägt. Nach 6 Monaten kennen wir alle relevanten Hausverwaltungen und die ersten sind gekauft. Nach 12 Monaten wurden alle relevanten Verwaltungen mehrfach von uns kontaktiert, und wir stehen mit allen in engem Austausch, die sich einen Verkauf vorstellen können.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust einen Datensatz mit allen relevanten Hausverwaltungen auf

  • Du entwickelst einen personalisierten Multi-Channel Outreach per E-Mail und Telefon und nutzt dafür moderne Tech Tools wie Clay, Smartlead und HubSpot

  • Du qualifizierst Verwaltungen und führst vielversprechende Gespräche zum Verkauf

  • Du unterstützt bei der Due Diligence und der Angebotserstellung

  • Du pflegst unser CRM konsistent und aktuell

title: Working Student Business Development / Pre-Sales Support (m/f/d)
description:
About Netlight
Netlight delivers premium IT consulting services across industries, standing out for our product- and technology-independent expertise. Our network of over 2000 role-models empowers aspiring digital leaders to excel in business-critical IT projects. Recognized as a top employer and for our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we continue to expand across Europe, with more than 10 international offices.

Role overview
We are looking for motivated, curious and creative working students to support our Hyperscaler Partnerships (AWS, GCP, Microsoft) in a Business Development / Technical Pre-Sales capacity.  
This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience working with our sales and technical teams, contributing to pre-sales activities, developing sales enablement materials, and assisting in proposal development to drive our commercial success ✨ 

Key responsibilities
  • Collaborate with sales and technical teams to support pre-sales activities. 
  • Support the organization of Netlight Internal Partnerships initiatives, from writing guides and administrating partner portal to helping organize internal workshops, retrospectives and creating necessary operational structures.  
  • Support development of some of our sales support tools and integrations.   
  •  Partner with our sales and technical teams to develop and customize technical presentations and sales enablement materials. 
  • Conduct market research and competitor analysis to inform sales strategies to identify trends and opportunities for our Hyperscaler Partnerships.  
  • Gather and analyze client feedback to enhance our service offerings.&n

title: B2B Marketing - India
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

description:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

More fleets are choosing Flock and our Customer Success team needs to grow. You will own a book of customers outright: onboarding them, keeping them engaged with their data, and getting them to renewal in better shape than they started. The role is built around the conversations our telematics makes possible, from quarterly reviews with fleet managers to safety interventions that follow a spike in risky driving, alongside a steady variety of inbound queries by phone and email. You hear first hand what matters to customers and brokers, and your suggestions for improving how we work carry real weight. AI is part of the day job too, because Flock runs on it. You will use it to prepare for meetings, dig into fleet data and stay on top of your book. You do not need insurance experience. You need the service instincts that make clients want to deal with you, and the appetite to learn everything else.

title: Key Account Manager (Oncology)
description:
On behalf of our client, a multinational pharmaceutical company specializing in oncology, we are looking for an experienced Key Account Manager to strengthen its commercial presence in Switzerland.

The Role & Key Responsibilities

As Key Account Manager (Oncology), you will be responsible for developing our client's presence in Switzerland, building strong relationships with key healthcare stakeholders, and driving commercial growth.

  • Develop and implement effective territory and key account strategies to achieve sales objectives.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with oncologists, hospital pharmacists, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and healthcare decision-makers.
  • Identify new business opportunities and strengthen partnerships with hospitals and leading oncology centers.
  • Promote the company's oncology portfolio, providing relevant scientific and clinical information to healthcare professionals.
  • Understand market dynamics, treatment pathways, and customer needs to develop tailored commercial approaches.
  • Collaborate closely with Medical Affairs, Marketing, and Market Access teams to support business development.
  • Monitor sales performance, competitor activities, and market trends, providing actionable insights.
  • Represent the company at medical congresses, scientific meetings, and industry events.
  • Ensure full compliance with Swiss pharmaceutical regulations and company policies.

Requirements

  • Experience in pharma is a mandate
  • Strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and results-driven approach.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build long-term relationships with healthcare professionals.
  • Genuine interest in oncology, scientific innovation, and patient-focused solutions.
  • Proactive, autonomous, well-organized

title: Enterprise Sales Director, Benelux
description:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What you'll do

  • Prospecting & lead generation: Identify and target potential customers through research, networking, and cold calling. Build new relationships with our enterprise customers and prospects to drive revenue, pipeline, and deployment capacity.

title: Venture Development Intern
description:
Venture Development Intern (m/f/d) – FastLeap Partners

Internship, 3–6 months · Full-time

About FastLeap Partners

FastLeap Partners is a company builder and investment firm headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, with portfolio companies mainly operating in Germany. It is backed by a small group of entrepreneurs and family offices from Germany and Switzerland with successful entrepreneurial track records. The firm has launched several ventures in sectors including HR, FinTech and EdTech – all cash-flow-driven and built with AI as their core foundation from day one.

About the internship

FastLeap Partners launches and scales several companies in parallel, from the first validation of a business model to an operating company with its own team. As a Venture Development Intern, you work at both ends of this process: you assess which new business models FastLeap Partners should pursue and launch next, and you help our portfolio companies tackle critical operational bottlenecks that constrain their growth.

You work as the right hand of the founder of FastLeap Partners and collaborate closely with the founders and teams of our portfolio companies. From day one, you are given a high degree of responsibility. You will take ownership of projects with a direct impact on the business success of FastLeap Partners and its portfolio companies.

Your responsibilities

Evaluating new business models

  • Validate business models through market research and customer development, including conversations with potential customers and partners.

  • Develop business cases and translate your findings into a clear recommendation: pursue, adapt or discontinue.

  • Build the talent pipeline: help assemble founding teams for new ventures and identify and engage early employees for the portfolio.

We are hiring a Product Partnerships Manager based in Germany with primary responsibility for Germany. The role is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing partnership strategies that accelerate adoption of OpenAI’s products across enterprise, developer, and consumer channels.

You will identify and manage relationships with strategic product partners in Germany and on cross-border opportunities, ranging from global technology platforms to regional champions, including enterprise software vendors, telcos, cloud providers, and government-aligned organizations. description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by

Lightspeed is seeking a Director of Product Management to own the Payments line of business within Financial Services. You will lead Group PMs and Senior PMs across North America and EMEA, and you will be accountable for payments penetration and GPV growth across our Retail and Hospitality platforms.

title: Caller / Scheduler
description:
Unison is a telecom and renewables infrastructure investment firm funded in partnership with Ardian - the global investment house based in Paris with over $150 billion in assets under management. Unison commenced operations in 2003 and today invests in real estate and infrastructure hosting wireless and renewables tenants in the United States and Europe. The Company is expanding rapidly and looking for talented, entrepreneurial team members to grow with us.

The Unison team is looking for an energetic, thorough caller to be the first point of contact for a pipeline of real estate investment leads. Reporting to the Director of Lead Generation, the Caller / Scheduler is responsible for helping grow the company by setting appointments for the Account Managers with real estate property owners to assist in developing a robust sales pipeline.

Manage personal pipeline of origination leads to set calls between site owners and Account Managers.

Achieve personal monthly, quarterly, and annual targets related to call settings and closings.

Rigorously monitor personal origination waterfall activity to ensure health and stability of sales pipeline.

Contribute user-experience input to origination processes such as data mining, CRM design, and marketing initiatives.

Contribute to strategic initiatives and product design to maintain a competitive market position.

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Prior experience in a call-center sales environment.

Natural ability to build rapport.

Familiarity with finance concepts such as IRR and NPV required.

Familiarity with real estate closing process is a plus.

Experience originating within commercial real estate, mortgages, telecom, mineral rights acquisition, or renewables industries is a plus.

Some college or equivalent experience required.

title: Business Innovation Manager (m/w/d) – AI, MarTech & Digital Solutions
description:
100% remote.

Neue AI-Tools, autonome Agenten, Automatisierungen, neue Plattformen oder smartere Wege, digitales Marketing effizienter zu machen: Wenn Technologie auf Marketing trifft, wirst Du neugierig.

Und noch besser: Du willst nicht nur darüber reden, sondern ausprobieren, bauen und umsetzen.

Wir sind eine unabhängige Digital-Performance-Agentur aus Deutschland und verbinden über 25 Jahre Marketing-Erfahrung mit AI, First-Party Data, eigener Technologie und datengetriebenen Lösungen.

Als Business Innovation Manager (m/w/d) arbeitest Du direkt mit unserem Director of Business Innovation und unserem Innovation-Team zusammen. Ihr identifiziert neue Möglichkeiten, testet Ideen und entwickelt daraus Lösungen, die bei uns und unseren Kunden tatsächlich etwas bewegen.

Kurz gesagt: Du machst aus „Das müsste man mal ausprobieren“ ein „Läuft.“

Dein Spielfeld:

  • Du findest heraus, was wirklich Potenzial hat.
    Neue AI-Anwendungen, APIs, Plattformen, Automatisierungen oder Entwicklungen im digitalen Marketing: Du behältst den Überblick, probierst Neues aus und bewertest, was für hurra.com und unsere Kunden echten Mehrwert bringt – und was einfach nur der nächste Hype ist.

  • Du baust Lösungen statt PowerPoints.
    Aus guten Ideen machst Du funktionierende Lösungen. Du entwickelst Prototypen, Tools, Automatisierungen und Workflows und bringst sie von der ersten Idee bis in den produktiven Einsatz. Dabei kann es um AI, Data, Search, Media, Content, Analytics oder ganz neue Marketing-Technologien gehen.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass gute Lösungen auch gut bleiben.
    Was funktioniert, wird nicht einfach abgehakt. Du entwickelst bestehende Tools und Anwendungen weiter, machst sie stabiler und skalierbarer und kümmerst Dich darum, dass sie im Alltag zuverlässig laufen.
